3:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This scenario has no $$Ｄトレーダー$$, but just in case, Scenario Demo 10 has been included.」

4:t_000:0.en:
$$ブライト$$
「...It's time. All units, brace for impact and get into formation.」

4:t_000:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The destruction of the $$時の牢獄$$ through $$時空修復$$... So this is the final moment.」

4:t_000:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「With the $$ジェミニス$$ threat driven off, the world will welcome a new era.」

4:t_000:4.en:
$$竜馬$$
「But we can't let our guard down.」

4:t_000:5.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Someday $$バアル$$ will come to Earth... We have to be ready for that.」

4:t_000:6.en:
$$アルト$$
「And there's that guy 《$$尸空#keyword$$》 from earlier, too.」

4:t_000:7.en:
$$甲児$$
「It's not just Earth that we're protecting. It's the entire universe.」

4:t_000:9.en:
$$タケル$$
「First, let's see our victory through to the end.」

4:t_000:10.en:
$$シンジ$$
「If possible, afterward... I'd like to rest a little.」

4:t_000:11.en:
$$キラ$$
「You're right. We're worn out, and so are our machines.」

4:t_000:12.en:
$$葵$$
「Even tough guys like us could use a little rest.」

4:t_000:13.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「A brief respite, huh... Not bad.」

4:t_000:14.en:
$$ブライト$$
「The countdown has started... The $$時の牢獄$$ will collapse any moment now.」

4:t_000:15.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...Good work, $n. Thank you for everything up to today.」

4:t_001:3.en:
$$赤木$$
「I don't really get it, but is that over there really Earth too!?」

4:t_002:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「Captain! Something is coming from where the boundary of the $$時の牢獄$$ used to be!」

4:t_003:2.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「The organization that man 《$$尸空#keyword$$》 mentioned, the one that includes the $$ジェミニス$$...」

4:t_003:4.en:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「Those guys are attacking from the other side of the $$時の牢獄$$!?」

4:t_003:5.en:
$$シンジ$$
「There are machines I've never seen before, too...!」

4:t_003:6.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Watch out! Their combat strength looks higher than the machines the $$ジェミニス$$ used!」

4:t_004:3.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Captain! Units believed to be $$サイデリアル$$ have also appeared in large numbers outside this area!」

4:t_004:4.en:
$$キャシー$$
「All of them are heading for Earth!」

4:t_004:5.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Were they waiting for the $$時の牢獄$$ to be destroyed...!」

4:t_004:6.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Message to all ships! We will split our forces to respond!」

4:t_004:7.en:
$$ブライト$$
「$$プトレマイオス$$, take $$ソレスタルビーイング$$, $$ヒイロ$$, $$ゼロ$$, and the others to Point 1204!」

4:t_004:10.en:
$$刹那$$
「We have to do this...! Earth has no strength left to fight now!」

4:t_004:11.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$キリコ$$, I'm borrowing your strength too.」

4:t_005:0.en:
$$ブライト$$
「$$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ and $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$ to Point 3022, and $$超銀河ダイグレン$$ to Point 2433!」

4:t_005:1.en:
$$ブライト$$
「$$ラー・カイラム$$ will report the situation to $$連邦軍$$ General HQ! $$アムロ$$, I'm leaving command of the escort forces to you!」

4:t_005:3.en:
$$ブライト$$
「The remaining ships, $$マクロス・クォーター$$, $$ネェル・アーガマ$$, and $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, will defend this area!」

4:t_005:5.en:
$$ブライト$$
「I've sent each group's formation data! All units, I'm counting on you!」

4:t_005:7.en:
$$葵$$
「Of course! We're not going to let those guys ruin our hard-won victory!」

4:t_005:8.en:
$$タケル$$
「Let's make sure we live and meet again!」

4:t_006:0.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Major $$オズマ$$, lead your team to Point 1528.」

4:t_006:1.en:
$$オズマ$$
「$$ウルズ$$ 1, $$ウルズ$$ 2, $$スカル$$ 2, $$ピクシー$$ 1, with me!」

4:t_006:3.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「I'm leaving this front to you, $$アルト$$!」

4:t_012:0.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「$$サイデリアル$$ forces are deploying!」

4:t_012:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「All units, form up for interception! We must never hand the Earth we protected over to the invaders!」

4:t_012:2.en:
$$クルツ$$
「But, man...! We've been in back-to-back battles, and our condition is the worst!」

4:t_012:4.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...I know. First comes the opening two minutes, I expect...」

4:t_012:6.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「...I have only one thing to say to all of you.」

4:t_012:7.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, make sure you come back alive! You must not die here!」

4:t_007:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「...That was probably only the enemy's first wave.」

4:t_008:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「As I thought, that was only the first wave...!」

4:t_009:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「This time it's a force with the new models as its main body...!」

4:t_009:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Other units are deployed to our rear as well!」

4:t_009:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「Damn...! There's no end to this!」
